message:
docs(observe): where TLS is terminated is a choice, and 1m is not a promise

Two gaps in the operator section.

The directory server can do TLS itself -- REMOTE60_DIR_TLS_KEY and
REMOTE60_DIR_TLS_CERT, both required -- so "put nginx in front" and "let the
server do it" are two configurations and the code picks neither for you.
Behind a proxy those stay empty and the upstream is plain http, which makes
the server print its "TLS is off, tokens travel in clear" warning at
startup. That warning is correct in that setup and is not a reason to
change it back.

And if the proxy is on another machine the upstream is not 127.0.0.1; that
hop is LAN cleartext, which is worth saying out loud rather than leaving as
an inference.

The body limit said "at least 512KB" without saying nginx already defaults
to 1m. Someone reading the first version would go set something that was
already fine. What matters is the case where it was lowered: then the log
route 413s and nothing else does, so the only symptom is logs not arriving.
Check the current value rather than trusting either default.
